description: ACT-managed settings for an agent registration. Only members of the Synapse Access and Compliance Team (ACT) may read or write these settings. This object is intentionally extensible; additional settings may be added in the future.

allowAnonymousChatSession.description: When true, anonymous users may start a 'PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE' chat session with this registered agent. When false or null, anonymous users may not use this agent.
